Hugging Face says it removed the built-in alignment of its UltraChat and UltraFeedback training data, which made the model more helpful but also more likely to produce problematic text.

summary.text: Zephyr 7B β is the second model in Hugging Face's Zephyr series, a 7B chat assistant fine-tuned from Mistral 7B v0.1 and published as open weights under the MIT licence. Its technical report describes distilled supervised fine-tuning followed by distilled preference optimization on AI feedback, without human annotation; the training code followed in the Alignment Handbook.

summary.text: Zephyr 7B Gemma is the third model in Hugging Face's Zephyr series, a 7B chat assistant fine-tuned from Google's Gemma 7B and published as open weights under the Gemma Terms of Use. It was fine-tuned on the DEITA 10K dataset, aligned with DPO on about 7k GPT-4-ranked prompts, and released with an Alignment Handbook recipe for aligning Gemma 7B with RLAIF.

summary.text: Idefics2 is an 8B multimodal model from Hugging Face that takes interleaved text and images and generates text, published as open weights under Apache 2.0 in base, instruction-tuned and chatty checkpoints. It is built on Mistral-7B-v0.1 and SigLIP, handles images at native resolution up to 980 x 980 pixels, and Hugging Face says it has enhanced OCR compared with Idefics1.

summary.text: SmolLM is a family of small open-weight language models from Hugging Face in 135M, 360M and 1.7B sizes, each released as a base and an instruction-tuned checkpoint under Apache 2.0. Hugging Face trained them on its SmolLM-Corpus and presents them as small enough to run locally on devices from smartphones to laptops.

summary.text: SmolVLA is a 450M-parameter open-weight vision-language-action model for robotics from Hugging Face's LeRobot project. It pairs SmolVLM2 with an action expert trained with flow matching to turn camera images, robot state and an optional instruction into continuous actions; Hugging Face says it can run on a CPU and pretrained it on community-shared LeRobot datasets.

summary.text: SmolLM3 is a 3B-parameter open-weight language model from Hugging Face, released under Apache 2.0 as a base model and an instruct model with switchable extended thinking. It natively supports six languages and handles up to 128k tokens of context, and Hugging Face published its architecture details, data mixtures and training configurations.

description.text: Hugging Face is a company founded in 2016, incorporated in the US as Hugging Face, Inc., with its main EU establishment in Paris. It runs a platform for hosting and sharing machine learning models and datasets, offers courses and tools, and says it works to democratise AI and machine learning. It also releases open models, including the SmolLM and SmolVLM families.
